title: Three-dimensional A1 shell projection supplies a finite QFT-compatible filtration candidate
question: Does the exact three-dimensional side-16 shell closure S0 -> S1 -> S2 turn the finite F_ref Fourier comparison into the canonical A1 heat-root and production-filtration owner required by R-192?
method: Start from the exact |n|^2=3 side-16 seed shell S0={-1,+1}^3 and apply the declared local support rule C(S)=S+2(S-S) modulo (Z/16Z)^3 for two iterations.

Reconstruct the supports independently with separate standard-library integer set arithmetic, derive coordinate projections, nesting, proper endpoint status, and preservation by a diagonal quadratic Fourier heat multiplier.

Compile the exact cardinal factors and quadratic-core positivity with pinned Lean R206, then run primary, non-importing independent, and integrated hostile-mutation lanes while preserving the R-192 owner boundary.
finding: The declared finite three-dimensional closure is exact: the support cardinalities are 8, 216, and 512; the coordinate projections are {1,15}, {1,3,5,11,13,15}, and all odd residues; the filtration is nested and the endpoint is a proper 512-point subset of the 4096-point torus. A diagonal quadratic heat proxy preserves every filtration level and the A1 quadratic core has the positive exact lower bound 26000000000947494031/100000000000000000000. This is a stronger finite QFT-compatible comparison object than the one-dimensional candidate, but it does not identify the canonical nonlinear production mobility, heat-root incidence, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner, or one-use q-ledger.
decision_reason: The finite Fourier support rule is an explicitly declared projection and not a derivation from the nonlinear A1 production backend. Treating its diagonal heat multiplier as the production dynamics would replace the missing R-192 owner slots by a chosen proxy and would conflate finite F_ref comparison with a QFT construction. The exact computation is therefore advanced as a T0 comparison candidate while the production route remains blocked at heat-root incidence.
boundary: No R-192 completion, A13/T-050 closure, interacting Gibbs measure, OS/KMS or real-time theorem, physical-empty ordering, removal, continuum, thermodynamic, Sector-A or Pre-A conclusion follows. Conditional replicas, raw-current spatial identity, production one-use q-ledger and canonical production owner remain absent.
next_action: Keep the 512-point odd-residue cube as a finite comparison baseline. Advance R-192 only after a hash-pinned full A1 nonlinear heat-root law, conditional replica construction, raw-current spatial identity and one-use nonnegative q-ledger are supplied on the complete production cylinder.
